title: Edge rusher DJ Wonnum to sign with the Lions

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Edge rusher DJ Wonnum to sign with the Lions
sources.description: Free agent defensive end DJ Wonnum is signing with the Lions on a one-year deal with a maximum value of $6 million, Tom Pelissero of NFL Media reports.
